name: Unresolved Structure Taxonomy Registry
purpose: Classify unresolved structures by type, repairability, scope limitation, theorem impact, and propagation risk before attempting closure.

taxonomy_classes.meaning: Artifact lacks operational completion but appears locally repairable.
Artifact exists conceptually but lacks operational grounding.
Artifact moves between admissible and unstable regimes under recursive pressure.
Artifact appears stable while concealing recursive instability.
Artifact may be meaningful locally but cannot be resolved as global closure.
Artifact represents a permanently open boundary condition or incompleteness constraint.
Artifact is intentionally isolated from propagation.

initial_unresolved_targets.name: LAW034 Global Composition Boundary
initial_unresolved_targets.risk: Local composition may be misread as global closure.

initial_unresolved_targets.name: Interrupted RC Recursive Stability Assumptions
initial_unresolved_targets.risk: High-recursion stability may be assumed without complete operational discharge.

initial_unresolved_targets.name: Symbolic Recursive Scaffolds
initial_unresolved_targets.risk: Conceptual plausibility may propagate as operational support.

initial_unresolved_targets.name: Deceptive Constraint Grooves
initial_unresolved_targets.risk: False stability may enter proof eligibility.

initial_unresolved_targets.name: Persistent Failure Geometry Scars
initial_unresolved_targets.risk: Some scarred structures may not be cleanly repairable.

initial_unresolved_targets.name: Metastable Recovery Regions
initial_unresolved_targets.risk: Recovery may remain threshold-sensitive and not proof-safe.

initial_unresolved_targets.name: Quarantined RC Artifacts
initial_unresolved_targets.risk: Quarantine bypass could contaminate theorem-facing layers.

resolution_outputs.meaning: Structure may be repaired by completing artifacts, validators, or result traces.
Structure may be converted from symbolic scaffold into tested operational artifact.
Structure needs adversarial simulation or recursion testing.
Structure is acceptable only within explicit local or finite-depth boundaries.
Structure must remain isolated from theorem-facing propagation.
Structure is preserved as an irreducible open boundary or incompleteness condition.
